messages:
maria: heads-up — during a routine canary we saw some request logs land in staging S3 with full query strings. can someone quick-check if anything sensitive got written? :eyes:
ashok: which bucket/path? and timeline?
maria: s3://redwood-staging-logs/2026-03-16/canary/ — files between 03:10–03:25 UTC. i pulled one sample — i’ll paste below with obvious redaction, LMK if you need the raw securely.
lin: thanks, paste is fine for triage. can you confirm this was only staging not prod?
maria: yes staging only. sample (redacted):
```
2026-03-16T03:12:07Z INFO request id=abc123 path=/v1/generate user_id=3852 user_email=REDACTED prompt="summarize user email: REDACTED" response_time_ms=120
2026-03-16T03:12:07Z DEBUG kv_cache_hit=true session_token=REDACTED model=gpt-large tokens=34
```
ashok: that looks redacted — do we have any files where user_email or session_token are NOT REDACTED?
maria: one file earlier in the batch had a raw line with user_email=jane.doe@example-corp.com but only in staging. i flagged it and replaced the file with a redacted copy; original still in lifecycle before overwrite forensics.
security-bot: incident-bot detected potential PII exposure: count=1 files affected=1 severity=low (staging) — please follow PII-EXPOSED runbook and create an incident ticket if escalation needed.
lin: ok please create a short incident ticket and include s3 path + SHA of original. Sara / security, are we good to do an internal comms note only or escalate to customer?
sara: thanks — quick answers: (1) staging-only, (2) single file, (3) data appears to be a single internal test account email. we should not notify customers. create ticket, tag privacy, mark severity low, and redact artifact.
maria: ticket created: INC-2026-2145. i uploaded redacted copy and a forensic snapshot to secure drive. need approval to run a fast audit job to list other files in time window (read-only).
ashok: +1 for read-only audit. devops-bot, can you run a list-by-prefix for 2026-03-16/03:10-03:25 and return object inventory?
devops-bot: queued job job-id=job-789; ETA ~2m. results will be posted to INC-2026-2145.
lin: comms draft for internal slack: "FYI — staging-only log file contained one test email. file has been redacted and archived. no customer data exposed. security-led audit in progress." OK?
sara: OK from legal/privacy. i'd add: "no action required by product teams" at end.
maria: posting now to #eng and updating ticket. thanks all. :+1:
security-bot: runbook note: evidence-preserved, artifact-redacted, audit-scheduled.
